title: AtpRecordHandle
description: The protocol-visible response to an emit: the durable evidence coordinate assigned to the record and its delivery lifecycle. Acknowledgement resolves on collector commit (ATP-0001 §9.1 stage 13).

producer_id.description: Registry-assigned 128-bit producer identifier, lowercase hex (16 bytes).

boot_epoch.description: Durable strictly-increasing epoch for this producer (ATP-0001 §8.2).

sequence.description: Per-(producer_id, boot_epoch) monotonic record sequence. The triple (producer_id, boot_epoch, sequence) is unique for all time (ATP-0001 §8.1).

status.description: Delivery lifecycle. A record is never silently dropped (ATP-0001 §8.4); on back-pressure the emit blocks or fails closed rather than returning a drop.

error.description: Present only when status is rejected. code is an ATP-0001 Appendix C error code.
